subject.title: feat(watchos): connect directly to Gateway as a node

question: After the retry/proof blockers are addressed, should this PR establish the direct watchOS node credential and HTTPS polling contract in core, or should the linked feature remain design-only for now?
rationale: The change crosses watchOS UX, Gateway auth, device-token storage, node capability whitelisting, and network exposure boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve scoped direct-node contract after fixes
options.body: Land a separately forgettable, foreground-only watch credential flow with bounded commands once the retry bug and physical-device proof are addressed.

options.title: Defer direct watch node
options.body: Keep the iPhone relay as the only supported watch path until maintainers are ready to own direct watch networking and support burden.

options.title: Split the design
options.body: Break setup handoff, Gateway HTTP polling, watch credential storage, and command policy into smaller owner-reviewed PRs.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped direct-node contract after fixes
recommendation.body: Land a separately forgettable, foreground-only watch credential flow with bounded commands once the retry bug and physical-device proof are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the feature request and has the strongest recent history on the exact iOS/watch paths involved.
